newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus in alliance with Fox studio.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus in alliance with Fox studio.

text.p: French pay TV channel Canal Plus said on Tuesday it had entered a long-term agreement with News Corporation unit 20th Century Fox allowing it to have rights for all Fox films for encrypted broadcasts.
The "strategic alliance" also involves the development of channels to be carried on each company's networks around the world, Canal Plus said in a statement.
"The exclusive agreement incorporates the acquisition rights of all Fox films for encrypted pay television," Canal Plus said.
"This agreement encompasses the Canal Plus premium pay television service, the pay-per-view service KIOSQUE and the mini-pay Cine-Cinemas and Cine-Cinefil channels," the statement said.
